title: A ROLL NO LONGER HOLDS UP THE GUN YOU ARE DRAWING
why: The draw clock did not run during a roll, so a roll straight after a swap froze it for the whole 0.38 s of the roll, while the reload already keeps going through a roll (v13.83). Proven in the cloud with the real keys: swap to the Longshot and it is ready after about 0.85 s; swap and roll at once and it was ready after about 1.26 s. The draw clock now runs in the roll branch beside the reload, once a frame either way, so the gun is drawn on time through a roll.
now: Rolling while you draw a gun no longer makes the draw take longer.
